Djurgården è l'isola dei musei: ABBA Museum, Vasa (la nave del 1628 intatta), Skansen (museo all'aperto) — raggiungibile in tram, traghetto o bici.
Il Gamla Stan (città vecchia medievale) è piccolo ma bellissimo: esplora le stradine al mattino presto prima che arrivi la folla del mezzogiorno.
Le crociere nell'arcipelago (skärgård) sono una delle esperienze più belle — partono dallo Strandvägen da fine aprile a settembre: non perderle.

quick_tips_en: Stockholm uses the Swedish krona (SEK), not euros — but the city is nearly entirely cashless: card is accepted everywhere, even for tiny amounts.
Djurgården is the island of museums — ABBA Museum, Vasa (the intact 1628 warship), Skansen (open-air museum): reachable by tram, ferry or bicycle.
Gamla Stan (medieval old town) is small but beautiful — explore its alleys early in the morning before the midday crowds arrive.
Archipelago cruises (skärgård) are among the best experiences — they depart from Strandvägen from late April to September: do not miss them.
Systembolaget (the state alcohol monopoly) is the only place to buy wine and spirits — open limited hours and closed on Sundays: plan accordingly.

foods.description_en: A Swedish cinnamon and cardamom bun, soft and fragrant, a symbol of everyday fika. It should be buttery but light, with well-distributed spices, a slightly glossy surface and elastic crumb that stays fresh. Quality also lies in cardamom aroma and even baking.

foods.description_en: An open sandwich with plenty of shrimps, egg, mayonnaise, dill and lemon, often served on white or rye bread. It is fresh and generous: quality depends on the shrimps, measured sauce and bread that can hold everything.
foods.description_fr: Un sandwich ouvert avec de nombreuses crevettes fraîches, œufs, mayonnaise, aneth et citron, servi comme plat léger ou entrée élégante. Un classique de la cuisine suédoise, raffiné et savoureux.

foods.name: Sill
foods.description: Aringa marinata in versioni dolci, acidule, speziate o cremose, servita con patate, panna acida, erba cipollina e pane. È centrale nelle feste svedesi: sapore deciso, acidità controllata e forte legame con tavole stagionali. Deve restare fresco e brillante, mai coperto da marinature troppo dolci.
foods.description_en: Pickled herring in sweet, tangy, spiced or creamy versions, served with potatoes, sour cream, chives and bread. It is central to Swedish celebrations: bold flavour, controlled acidity and a strong bond with seasonal tables. It should stay fresh and bright, never covered by overly sweet marinades.
foods.description_fr: Du hareng mariné en versions sucrées, acidulées, épicées ou crémeuses (à la moutarde, à l'aneth, à la crème), servi avec pommes de terre chaudes et crème fraîche. Un incontournable du smörgåsbord et de la cuisine de fête en Suède.

foods.description: Torta svedese a strati con pan di Spagna, crema, panna montata, confettura e copertura verde di marzapane. È scenografica ma delicata: la qualità sta nella leggerezza della panna, nel marzapane sottile e nella dolcezza non eccessiva.
foods.description_en: A Swedish layered cake with sponge, custard, whipped cream, jam and green marzipan covering. It is theatrical but delicate: quality lies in light cream, thin marzipan and sweetness that is not excessive. The best slice keeps structure without losing its airy, creamy softness.

neighborhoods.name: Gamla Stan
neighborhoods.description: L'isola medievale di Stoccolma, con i vicoli colorati, i palazzi del XVII secolo, il Palazzo Reale e la Cattedrale. L'unico quartiere dove si può dormire immersi nel cuore storico. Prezzi alti, molto turistica ma di grande fascino.
neighborhoods.description_en: Stockholm's medieval island, with colourful alleys, 17th-century palaces, the Royal Palace and the Cathedral. The only district where you can sleep immersed in the historic heart. High prices, very touristy but extremely charming.
neighborhoods.description_fr: L’île médiévale de Stockholm, avec ruelles colorées, palais du XVIIe siècle, Palais royal et cathédrale. Le seul quartier où dormir plongé dans le cœur historique. Prix élevés, très touristique mais extrêmement charmant.

neighborhoods.name: Södermalm
neighborhoods.description: L'isola a sud del centro, bohémien e alternativa. Il quartiere più cool di Stoccolma: caffè specialty, ristoranti creativi, negozi vintage, gallerie d'arte e una vivace vita notturna. Molto amato dai locali e dai viaggiatori giovani. Prezzi medi.
neighborhoods.description_en: The island south of the centre, bohemian and alternative. Stockholm's coolest district: speciality cafés, creative restaurants, vintage shops, art galleries and a vibrant nightlife. Very popular with locals and young travellers. Medium prices.
neighborhoods.description_fr: L’île au sud du centre, bohème et alternative. Le quartier le plus branché de Stockholm, avec cafés de spécialité, restaurants créatifs, boutiques vintage, galeries d’art et vie nocturne animée. Très apprécié des habitants et des jeunes voyageurs. Prix moyens.

neighborhoods.name: Östermalm
neighborhoods.description: Il quartiere più elegante e ricco di Stoccolma, con l'Östermalms Saluhall (il mercato coperto più bello della città), boutique di lusso, ristoranti stellati e palazzi del XIX secolo. Atmosfera sofisticata. Prezzi alti. Ideale per chi cerca comfort premium.
neighborhoods.description_en: Stockholm's most elegant and wealthy district, with Östermalms Saluhall (the city's most beautiful covered market), luxury boutiques, Michelin-starred restaurants and 19th-century buildings. Sophisticated atmosphere. High prices. Ideal for those seeking premium comfort.
neighborhoods.description_fr: Le quartier le plus élégant et aisé de Stockholm, avec Östermalms Saluhall, le plus beau marché couvert de la ville, des boutiques de luxe, des restaurants étoilés et des immeubles du XIXe siècle. Atmosphère raffinée et prix élevés. Idéal pour un confort haut de gamme.
